# The Bridal Photography

> The Bridal Photography is a wedding and family photography studio based in Pune, India, working since 2014. It has offices in Pune, Mumbai and Goa and covers weddings, pre wedding shoots, engagements, maternity, baby and newborn shoots, wedding films and events.

We work across Pune, Mumbai, Goa, Ahilyanagar, Lonavala, Mahabaleshwar, Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Satara, Lavasa, Mulshi and Lakshadweep. Packages start from ₹6,000. Prices can change, so check the package pages or call for the latest quote.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 83903 67637
- Email: thebridal11@gmail.com
- Pune Office 1: Sai Temple, Sacchaimata, Sr.No.40/1B, Near Prathmesh Heights, Narhe Ambegaon Rd, Katraj, Pune, Maharashtra 411046
- Pune Office 2: Shriram Soc, 858/61, Guruwar Peth, Pune, Maharashtra 411042
- Mumbai Office: 1st Floor, Modi House, Off Link Rd, near Fun Republic Road, Andheri West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400053
- Goa Office: Second Floor, Prema Building, Fontainhas, Patto Colony, Panaji, Goa 403001
